corrections.text: The article states that the advisories "did not list CVE identifiers or CVSS scores; the project describes each only as high-rated." The advisory pages do list CVSS v4 base scores: 7.3 for GHSA-mvvg-497x-hmj8 (CVSS:4.0/AV:L/AC:H/AT:P/PR:L/UI:P/VC:H/VI:H/VA:H/SC:H/SI:H/SA:H), 8.6 for GHSA-xwqc-3h47-hg64 (CVSS:4.0/AV:L/AC:L/AT:N/PR:L/UI:P/VC:H/VI:H/VA:H/SC:H/SI:H/SA:H) and 8.6 for GHSA-j5m7-59rp-24f5 (CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:H/AT:P/PR:N/UI:P/VC:H/VI:H/VA:N/SC:N/SI:H/SA:N). Each advisory shows "CVE ID: No known CVE" at the time of review.

The article states that the advisories "do not say how the issues were discovered or reported." GHSA-xwqc-3h47-hg64 credits st4rain as reporter and GHSA-j5m7-59rp-24f5 credits opensec-intelligence as reporter; GHSA-mvvg-497x-hmj8 lists no reporter.
